gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-kannad: Relaxed is the first word for Fuzzy Bubbles, with its rounded, inviting letters and drafting-pen line. And Noto Sans Kannada follows with a gentle step up to capitals and s curves that open wide, so the whole pair feels friendly.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-kayah-: Fuzzy Bubbles draws everything in one monoline stroke, rounded and personal, with lowercase nearly matching its capitals in height. Noto Sans Kayah Li stays clean beside it, lifting its brush ends away before each curve can close.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-kharos: Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays down a dark, thick stripe of lowercase. Its curves never close up, and that sets off the hand-drawn Fuzzy Bubbles, whose horizontals match its verticals in thickness, making a friendly, approachable pair.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Fuzzy Bubbles looks like neon glass tubing bent into soft, rounded letters, relaxed and personal. But it's at big, short sizes that it earns its keep, with Noto Sans Khmer standing proud and open nearby.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Strokes of a single weight give Fuzzy Bubbles a flat, stencil-cut feel, though the rounded letters stay inviting. Noto Sans Khojki then carries on with exits wide enough to pass light and a large, clear eye on every e.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-khudaw: Noto Sans Khudawadi reads clean and approachable, its small letters close to capital height and its rounds left unlatched like a hook. Fuzzy Bubbles is the hand-drawn one, each stroke carrying the same visual weight.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR has a big x-height, stubby ascenders and descenders, and generous gaps in every curve. Fuzzy Bubbles is the relaxed hand, a stencil-brush line; Noto Sans KR does the steady reading.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-lao: Fuzzy Bubbles builds its uppercase from lines of one constant thickness. That handwritten heading brings warmth, while Noto Sans Lao lifts its x-height well above the usual and keeps its mouths open on every c, e, and a.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-lao-lo: Noto Sans Lao Looped sets words as solid blocks, not skylines. Fuzzy Bubbles hands over its identical bar thickness and rounded, personal letters, and the looped body, with bowls left unfinished on one side, settles in underneath.
